title: Back to School
description: We get it—getting back into the school routine. From improving study habits and creating comfortable workspaces to staying on top of tasks and making smart financial choices—these prompts are designed to help students feel less overwhelmed and more motivated. Paired with advanced features like OCR for scanning homework, Doc Master for editing documents in any format, Text-to-Image for creating visuals for presentations, YouTube Summary for getting the gist of educational videos, and an additional set of prompts for rewriting and summarizing texts, the Back to School collection becomes a powerful tool for both learning and growth. Creating the best experience for our users has earned us the Silver Lovie Award and the People's Lovie Award. This only proves that whether it's drafting emails, polishing resumes, planning trips, solving math issues, or beyond, ChatOn keeps things simple, quick, and stress-free.
